name: PeMSD7 (PeMS-07)
description: A traffic forecasting benchmark derived from California Department of Transportation Performance Measurement System (PeMS) data. PeMSD7(M) covers 228 road sensors in District 7 (Los Angeles) at five-minute intervals over May–June 2012; PeMSD7(L) is a larger 883-sensor version spanning May–August 2012.
citation: Li, Y., Yu, R., Shahabi, C., & Liu, Y. (2018). Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network: Data-Driven Traffic Forecasting. International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR). https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.01926
